title: 第11章 试药第12章 蛊惑人心改
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
正当宋文觉得万事俱备，只等天色完全黑下来时。
四名天煞帮的帮众走入了院落，在小楼中住了下来，其中两人更是直接守在了他的门外。
这让宋文顿时傻眼了！
“极阴是察觉自己想要逃跑的意图了？”
“不可能啊，我一直伪装的极好啊，应该没有暴露才对。”
见逃生机会断绝，宋文在房间内来来回踱步，烦躁又不安。
他无论如何也没有想明白极阴是如何发现。
其实，极阴并没有发现宋文逃生的意图。
只是极阴行事小心谨慎惯了，他担心独立宋文一人，宋文会闯入二楼，窃取他的秘密和功法。
却是阴差阳错的阻碍了宋文的逃亡计划。
接下来几日，宋文都是在不安中度过，每当他想要搏命赌上一把，冒着被守卫发现的风险，尝试去攀爬崖壁试试之时，四名守卫强壮的身躯和腰间钢刀，又让他瞬间清醒过来。
宋文发现，寂静了多日的厢房区域，再次变得热闹起来。
不断有年轻人，被送入厢房，然后被拘禁起来，等待极阴的出关，传授他们修仙功法。
十日后，极阴终于出关了。
出关的极阴依旧是神采飞扬，他对自己此次炼制的丹药很有信心。
“宋文，跟为师上二楼，”
看着突然出现在面前的极阴，宋文脸色变得极为难看，他不知该如何反抗。
似乎自从在遇到苟航之后，自己就变成了砧板上的肉，再也没有反抗的能力。
宋文在几经犹豫之后，终还是跟着极阴上了二楼。
“将这丹药吃下去，它会大幅提高你的修为，只要你修为突破到第二层，就能成为天煞帮的核心成员，自由进出天煞帮了。”

极阴以利诱惑的说道。
此时，眼前的情况已经威胁到了宋文的生命安全，脸上的伪装再也维持不下去了。
他神情仇视的盯着极阴，想要一拳轰在极阴笑盈盈的脸上，不过他知自己肯定不是极阴的对手，若是自己惹怒了极阴，恐怕会和当初的小胖子一样，被极阴赏赐一张黄符，然后变成一个广岛长崎般的‘熟人’，化为一团灰烬。
弱小是原罪！
这一刻，宋文无比清晰的理解这句话。
极阴脸上突然浮现一抹冷笑，
“没想到，我的弟子中还有聪明人。看来你已经猜测出一切真相了。
不过本座劝你，不要试图反抗，乖乖吃下丹药，只要你能活下来，本座当真给你自由。”
“哐当！”
一枚婴儿巴掌大令牌被扔在地上。
极阴继续说道。
“这乃本座的令牌，只要有了这枚令牌，你便可以自由出入天煞帮任何地方。”
宋文看了看地上的令牌，又看了看极阴手中的丹药，在几番犹豫思索之后。
他接过了极阴手中的丹药，又捡起了地上的令牌。
“希望师尊能说话算数！”
实力不够，那就只有赌运气了。
content_en:
Just when Song Wen felt that everything was ready, he was just waiting for the sky to completely darken.
Four members of the Tiansha Gang walked into the courtyard and settled in the small building. Two of them even stood guard outside his door.
This made Song Wen suddenly dumbfounded!
"Did Ji Yin realize his intention to escape?"
"It's impossible. I've been pretending very well. I shouldn't have been exposed."
Seeing that the chance of escape was cut off, Song Wen paced back and forth in the room, irritated and uneasy.
He never figured out how Ji Yin discovered it.
In fact, Jiyin did not discover Song Wen's intention to escape.
It's just that Ji Yin is used to being cautious. He's worried that if Song Wen is alone, Song Wen will break into the second floor and steal his secrets and skills.
But it was a strange combination of circumstances that hindered Song Wen's escape plan.
Song Wen spent the next few days in a state of anxiety. Whenever he wanted to risk his life and risk being discovered by the guards and try to climb the cliff, the strong bodies of the four guards and the steel knives at their waists made him wake up instantly.
Song Wen discovered that the wing area, which had been silent for many days, became lively again.
Young people are constantly being sent to the wing and then detained, waiting for Ji Yin to come out and teach them the techniques of cultivating immortals.
Ten days later, Jiyin finally came out of seclusion.
Jiyin, who came out of seclusion, was still in high spirits. He was very confident in the elixir he had refined this time.
"Song Wen, follow me to the second floor."
Looking at Ji Yin who suddenly appeared in front of him, Song Wen's face became extremely ugly, and he didn't know how to resist.
It seems that since meeting Gou Hang, he has become meat on the chopping board and no longer has the ability to resist.
After several hesitations, Song Wen finally followed Ji Yin to the second floor.
"Eat this pill and it will greatly improve your cultivation. As long as your cultivation reaches the second level, you can become a core member of the Tiansha Gang and enter and exit the Tiansha Gang freely."
Jiyin Yili said seductively.
At this time, the situation in front of him had threatened Song Wen's life and safety, and the disguise on his face could no longer be maintained.
He stared at Ji Yin with hatred, and wanted to punch Ji Yin's smiling face, but he knew that he was definitely not Ji Yin's opponent. If he angered Ji Yin, he would probably be like the little fat man back then, who would be rewarded with a yellow talisman by Ji Yin, and then turn into a "familiar" like Hiroshima and Nagasaki, and turn into a ball of ashes.
Weakness is the original sin!
At this moment, Song Wen understood this sentence very clearly.
A sneer suddenly appeared on Ji Yin's face,
"I didn't expect that there are smart people among my disciples. It seems that you have guessed all the truth.
However, I advise you not to try to resist, but just take the elixir obediently. As long as you can survive, I will truly give you freedom. "
"Clang!"
A token as big as a baby's slap was thrown to the ground.
Jiyin continued.
"This is my token. As long as you have this token, you can freely enter and leave anywhere in the Tiansha Clan."
Song Wen looked at the token on the ground, then at the elixir in Ji Yin's hand, and after some hesitation and thought.
He took the elixir from Ji Yin's hand and picked up the token on the ground.
"I hope Master can keep his word!"
If you don't have enough strength, you can only gamble on luck.
